ideas.title: Following the Money in the Minnesota Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trail of the Minnesota fraud scandal, including the use of shell companies and the laundering of money. It would examine the role of state and local officials in the scandal, and the impact of the funding freeze on programs and services.
questions: What is the extent of the financial wrongdoing in the Minnesota fraud scandal?
How have state and local officials been involved in the scandal?
ideas.insight: The financial trail of the scandal is a critical aspect of the investigation, and could reveal significant wrongdoing by state and local officials. By following the money, we can gain a better understanding of the scope of the scandal and the impact on programs and services.

ideas.title: The Impact of the Funding Freeze on Minnesota Programs
ideas.description: This story would examine the impact of the federal funding freeze on programs and services in Minnesota, including those related to healthcare and education. It would investigate the effects on vulnerable populations, and the potential long-term consequences of the freeze.
questions: What programs and services have been impacted by the funding freeze?
How have vulnerable populations been affected?
ideas.insight: The funding freeze has the potential to have a significant impact on programs and services in Minnesota, particularly those related to healthcare and education. By examining the effects of the freeze, we can gain a better understanding of the potential long-term consequences and the need for greater transparency and accountability.
